title: An overview of the uses of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《An overview of the uses of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are of concern because of their high persistence (or that of their degradation products) and their impacts on human and environmental health that are known or can be deduced from some well-studied PFAS.
